Usage

MJCF of a scene in which an open chute (floor length L, width B, back and side wall height wall) is packed on a grid with rigid spheres up to depth h0 (no mujoco needed). The chute is a mocap body (name="trough", origin = floor edge at the mouth, height lip_height); rotating it mouth-down (−θ about the y axis) is done by scoop_mujoco_pour, which writes mocap_quat every step. The floor is rough (sliding friction floor_mu, so the bottom layer does not slide out along the floor — the same role as the rough base in granular); the side walls use wall_mu. The mouth side of the floor (x < 0) is open, and spilled spheres fall and reach the ground (height 0). Returns: xml, positions, info (L, B, h0, wall, radius, lip_height, mass_each, n, timestep, A_fill = L·h0). Raises ValueError: h0 ≥ wall / contact_tc < 2 timestep / not even 1 layer of spheres fits / misspelling.
